how to do paris
like a local

say "bonjour" as you walk
into any shop

drink your coffee at the counter

it's cheaper than at a table.

ask for "une tradition"

the best baguette in the bakery.

lunch on the "formule"

starter and main, or main
and dessert, at a set price.

a picnic on the banks
of the seine

and before you go: one story about
the city a day instead of scrolling
